t: This is a statue of Abraham Lincoln, called Abraham Lincoln: The Man. It is a re-cast of an original work by the American sculptor Augustus Saint-Gaudens, and it was presented as a diplomatic gift from the United States to the United Kingdom. Lincoln was the sixteenth president of the United States, serving from 1861 until his assassination in 1865. He led the country through the Civil War, defeated the Confederacy and played a major role in ending slavery. Here, the statue stands as a lasting sign of friendship between the two nations.
